Use case: ui-mockup / illustration style exploration. Direction name: restrained editorial anime.

Style: closely grounded in the FIRST Solit screenshot, especially its small simple ordinary human characters, controlled thin dark outlines and flat restrained cel shading. Realistic adult proportions but SMALL unglossy eyes and plain natural facial features. Only 2-3 color values per surface. Simplified hair silhouettes, no detailed hair strands. Avoid the SECOND reference's glossy AI-anime aesthetic: no luminous eyes, no airbrushed skin, no oily gradients, no rim glow, no photorealistic texture, no lush hyper-detailed plants, no cinematic depth-of-field, no beautiful model faces, no grinning stock characters. No real municipality names. Date context 2026-10-18; no date needs to be visible.
